## EMST role: Environmental health specialist (state variant, lead level; P2)

*Match:* `skos:closeMatch`, confidence 0.6, unreviewed agent draft (`emst-x5-tx:R26-environmental-health-specialist/state:2586`). *Authority position (editorial):* regulator.

**Competency targets at this level (editorial draft target levels, agent-drafted)**

- Review plans and evaluate sites for environmental health permits — lead L4
- Investigate outbreaks, complaints and emerging environmental health hazards to control exposure — lead L4
- Develop and resolve environmental enforcement cases — lead L4
- Collect trace-level and genetic environmental samples without contamination — lead L3
- Manage field sample custody and field quality control — lead L3
- Communicate environmental and health risks under uncertainty — lead L4
- Plan and run extreme heat preparedness and response programmes — lead L3
- Assess human health risks from environmental exposures — lead L3
- Provide compliance and technical assistance to regulated entities and local governments — lead L3
- Calibrate field observers and run field measurement quality assurance — lead L3
- Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings — lead L2
- Interpret and question environmental data products in everyday work — lead L1
- Use AI tools responsibly in everyday environmental work — lead L1
- Validate AI-generated work products before professional use — lead L1
- Record provenance and AI involvement in work products — lead L1
- Coordinate environmental response operations within incident command — lead L4
- Build working partnerships with communities affected by environmental decisions — lead L4
- Conduct participatory and community-based environmental research — lead L4
- Conduct regulatory compliance inspections — lead L4

**Main tasks at this level (agent draft, in record order)**

*% time: set by the supervisor; EMST supplies none before job analysis.*

*Critical and needed-at-entry tasks: Assessment pending (job analysis).*

- Inspect a retail food establishment for foodborne illness risk factors, ranking violations by public-health risk and recording required corrections
- Evaluate an onsite wastewater site's soils, separation distances and proposed design before issuing a construction permit
- Review food establishment construction plans against code provisions for equipment, layout and plumbing before approving construction
- Inspect a public swimming pool's water chemistry, circulation and safety equipment, closing the pool when an imminent health hazard exists
- Collect food, water and environmental samples during an outbreak investigation following chain-of-custody and laboratory submission requirements
- Identify contributing factors of a foodborne outbreak from interviews with an implicated establishment's staff and review of its records
- Survey larval and adult mosquito populations at fixed and complaint sites following the vector programme's trapping protocol
- Select mosquito control measures from surveillance counts and arbovirus test results against the programme's action thresholds
- Investigate a reported environmental violation, establishing the facts, responsible party and applicable requirement before recommending an enforcement response
- Assemble the evidence file for an enforcement case, linking each alleged violation to the inspection findings, records and samples that prove it
- Testify as a fact or expert witness in an enforcement proceeding, explaining the evidence and methods behind each finding
- Plan contamination-controlled field sampling for genetic detection of a target species, setting sites, timing, replicates and field blanks

*Credential gates (issuer verified):* Registered Environmental Health Specialist / Registered Sanitarian (REHS/RS) (preferred); 1 not shown until the issuer is verified
